summary.goal: Define and implement MCP tools that agents use to communicate with Forgemaster. These tools are the only way agents report progress, completion, blockers, and request human input.

acceptance_criteria.description: report_progress tool: task_id, status (starting/working/blocked), message, progress_pct
report_complete tool: task_id, artifacts array, optional notes
report_blocked tool: task_id, reason, optional suggested_change for Planner
request_human_input tool: task_id, question, options, blocking_level: 'hard_block' | 'soft_block' | 'preference' | 'fyi', can_use_default, default_value
record_decision tool: task_id, question, chosen, alternatives[], reasoning - for trajectory capture
report_audit_result tool: task_id, result: 'pass' | 'fail', findings[] - for auditor agents
MCP server runs on Forgemaster, exposed to agents via config
Tool calls validated (unknown task_id rejected)
Tool calls trigger trajectory events

observations: MCP is the communication contract - agents don't access DB directly
Tools map to state transitions in Forgemaster
request_human_input creates Question entities in forge-question-queue
Same MCP pattern as planner-core but execution-focused
patterns: MCP server as Express HTTP endpoint
Agent spawned with --mcp-config pointing to Forge MCP
Tool calls update task state and emit trajectory events

blocking_levels.hard_block: Agent must wait for answer, execution paused
blocking_levels.soft_block: Agent should wait, but can proceed with default if timeout
blocking_levels.preference: Agent can proceed with best guess, answer updates behavior

steps.title: Create MCP tool response types
steps.description: Define response types for MCP tool handlers

acceptance_criteria.description: ToolSuccessResponse<T> = { success: true, data: T }
ToolErrorResponse = { success: false, error: string }
success<T>(data) and error(message) helper functions

steps.title: Define report_progress tool
steps.description: MCP tool for agents to report progress during task execution

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool schema: task_id (required), status: 'starting' | 'working' | 'blocked', message (required), progress_pct (optional, 0-100)
Handler validates task_id exists and belongs to caller's run
Emits trajectory event with type='agent_progress'
Updates agent heartbeat timestamp for health monitoring
Returns { success: true, data: { acknowledged: true } }

specification.pattern_description: Copy tool schema pattern with name, description, inputSchema object

steps.title: Define report_complete tool
steps.description: MCP tool for agents to report task completion with artifacts

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool schema: task_id (required), artifacts: [{ type, reference, metadata? }][], notes (optional)
Handler creates Artifact entities for each artifact via ForgeStorage
Updates task status to 'auditing' if step.audit=true, else 'completed'
Emits trajectory event with type='task_completed'
Returns { success: true, data: { task_status, artifacts_created: number } }

specification.notes: Auditor dispatch handled separately by forge-auditor-dispatch feature

steps.title: Define report_blocked tool
steps.description: MCP tool for agents to report they are blocked

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool schema: task_id (required), reason (required), suggested_change (optional object for Planner feedback)
Handler updates task status to 'blocked'
If suggested_change provided, triggers forge-planner-adapter ChangeRequest creation
Emits trajectory event with type='task_blocked'
Returns { success: true, data: { task_status: 'blocked', change_request_id? } }

steps.title: Define request_human_input tool
steps.description: MCP tool for agents to ask questions that require human answers

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool schema: task_id (required), question (required), options (optional string[]), blocking_level: 'hard_block' | 'soft_block' | 'preference' | 'fyi', can_use_default (bool), default_value (optional)
Handler creates Question entity via ForgeStorage.createQuestion()
If blocking_level is hard_block or soft_block, updates task status to 'blocked'
Emits trajectory event with type='human_input_requested'
Emits SSE event 'question_added' for UI notification
Returns { success: true, data: { question_id, blocking: bool } }

specification.pattern_description: Similar to ask_user_question in planner-core but execution-focused
specification.notes: Question entity schema and advanced queue logic owned by forge-question-queue feature

steps.title: Define record_decision tool
steps.description: MCP tool for agents to record important decisions for trajectory capture

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool schema: task_id (required), question (required), chosen (required), alternatives (string[]), reasoning (required)
Handler creates trajectory event with type='decision_recorded'
Decision stored with full context for retrospective analysis
Returns { success: true, data: { event_id, recorded: true } }

specification.pattern_description: Similar to DecisionEvent pattern in planner-core trajectory

steps.title: Define report_audit_result tool
steps.description: MCP tool for auditor agents to report verification results

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool schema: task_id (required), result: 'pass' | 'fail', findings: [{ criterion_id, status: 'pass' | 'fail', details }]
Handler validates all acceptance criteria have corresponding findings
Stores findings in task_attempts.audit_findings JSONB
Emits trajectory event with type='audit_completed'
Returns { success: true, data: { task_status, findings_count } }

specification.pattern_description: Add to existing Forge MCP tools registry
specification.notes: Audit pass/fail handling and retry logic owned by forge-auditor-dispatch feature

steps.description: Implement tool registry and switch-based handler dispatch

acceptance_criteria.description: tools: Tool[] array with all 6 tool definitions
handleToolCall(storage, trajectoryCapture, name, args) function with switch dispatch

Returns toCallToolResult() for all responses

steps.title: Create MCP HTTP server
steps.description: Express-based HTTP server for MCP tool calls

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /mcp/tools/list returns { tools: Tool[] }
POST /mcp/tools/call accepts { name, arguments } and returns CallToolResult
Validates task_id in authorization context (X-Task-ID header)
Configurable port (default 3100)

steps.title: Implement answer notification to waiting agents
steps.description: When a question is answered, notify the waiting agent via relay message

acceptance_criteria.description: When question answered, send relay message to agent with answer
Message format: { type: 'question_answered', question_id, answer }
If task was blocked, update status back to 'running'
Log notification in trajectory
